{{Quote|I've identified one of the assassins as an operative for Colonel Langor, a man with ties to the Imperial Science Bureau.|Eckard Lokin|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Langor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with ties to the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he sent assassins to ambush [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Eckard Lokin]] in one of his safe warehouses.
